_prompt:
You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: When a child of the dialog uses autoFocus, focus does not return to the element that opened the dialog after it closes.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] D5/focus: a child with `autoFocus` inside a Dialog leaves focus on body after close. The `previous` element is captured in the open effect, after the child's autoFocus has already moved focus into the dialog, so it is the child, which is removed on close. Probe: opener button → open → `<input autoFocus>` → click close → `document.activeElement` is `<body>`, expected the opener. Control without autoFocus passes.
- [blocking] D3/focus trap: `TabPanel` sets `tabIndex={0}` even when `hidden`, and `focusableWithin` does not filter hidden subtrees. The last "focusable" is therefore a hidden panel's button. Probe: Dialog containing Tabs (panel "a" selected, panel "b" hidden, each with a button); focus A1 (the visible last), `user.tab()` → focus goes to body, expected the first tab. The trap does not catch it.
- [blocking] Triggered check, active item in a changing list: `active` is stored as an index into `options`. Probe: highlight Banana with ArrowDown×2, then prepend Zucchini to options, then Enter → `onChange` called with "a" (Apple), expected "b". Wrong item committed.
- [blocking] C8: blur after clearing the text calls `onChange(null)` and leaves the input empty. C8 says blur restores the text to the selected label. Probe with a stateful parent (value "a", clear text, click elsewhere) → `seen=[null]`, `text=""`. The existing "blur with empty text clears the value" test codifies the deviation, so the spec conflict needs an orchestrator decision.
- [minor] Duplicate Tab values (`"d"`, `"d"`) yield duplicate DOM ids (2 unique of 3 tab ids). Not a crash; the input is invalid.
- [minor] Enter with empty text and no active option clears the value. C5 says "Enter with no active option does nothing." This is deliberate per the triggered-check wording, so it is an open question, not a bug.
- [minor, not reproduced] Combobox sets `id={inputId}` after `{...rest}`, so a consumer `id` is silently dropped. TabPanel overrides consumer `hidden` and `tabIndex`. Code reading only.
- [minor, not reproduced] Tab `aria-controls` points at a panel id that does not exist if the consumer does not render that TabPanel. Code reading only.
